<!-- pr-reviewer: 845228ac056222ee72b85b686157cf30658ebace -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I read the complete diff and the current upstream `AGENTS.md`.
There is no earlier review to check.

The picks use the existing command history and MCP field. The generator keeps the complete contour before the exit run.
The cover and kerf laws still check the complete path. Both doors refuse an exit pick with control compensation.

## Local build and tests

PR head: `845228ac056222ee72b85b686157cf30658ebace`.
Base: `f287a370c81b60d24cfaf026cfa04afeb7943bbd`.
Trial merge: `839a5ed0a24b3d91a23e1942188943f5ff10530b`. Its first parent is the PR head.
All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3986`. No GitHub runner was used.
The cache wrapper stalled before it produced an artifact. I disabled it for the completed commands.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 762 steps; 761 passed; one UI step failed; zero stalled. 7,783 tests passed. The seven UI failures also occur on bare main. |
| Motion library | 672 passed; 22 ignored. All nine new plasma tests passed. |
| `start_exit_shared` | 11 passed, including all seven new plasma tests. |
| `mcp_plasma` | 6 passed, including the new pick test. |
| `golden_cl` | 34 passed, without regeneration. |
| `example_catalog` | 43 passed; 4 ignored. |
| `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed. |
| `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed. |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | All six steps passed; all 11 light tests passed; zero stalled. |
| `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed. |

The light steps were the release build, `motion light: lib`, `adaptive_troch_island`,
`adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and `app light: pocket_pass_start`.
The full heavy lanes were not run. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, "Heavy lanes at review", does not require them for this P2 PR.

## Host failures checked on bare main

This headless host provides no GPU adapter to the tests. I ran the same UI command from `crates/ui`
on bare main `f287a370c81b60d24cfaf026cfa04afeb7943bbd`:

`cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-ui --no-fail-fast --lib -- --test-threads=16`

Both trees gave 1,642 passed, seven failed, and eight ignored. The failed tests are identical:

- `egui_app::report_tests::a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window`
- `egui_app::report_tests::no_answer_copies_nothing`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_title_field_travels_into_the_url`
- `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`

The first six fail with:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

The last fails with:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

These are host failures, not PR blockers.

The added file is under `crates/app/tests/golden/`. I checked the directory readers and their shared golden helpers.
The quick plan ran every app suite and the post fixture readers by name. Their individual results are below.
This includes `solid_law_goldens`, `plasma_post`, `plasma_post_refusals`, `post_serves_plasma`, and all three catalog suites.
No importer source or STEP fixture changed. The additional kernel importer suites do not apply.
